note: two_ev_conflicting: Two EVs, N and E simultaneously — arbitration must be a model output
two_ev_same_approach: Two EVs same approach, 20 s apart — queued requests, no double preemption
two_ev_opposing: Two EVs N->S and S->N — non-conflicting, can both be served?
false_positive_horn: Car horn from UrbanSound8K — phantom preemption, cost measured
false_positive_music: Street music / jackhammer — harder negative
weak_confidence: p(siren) just above threshold — should PREPARE, not PREEMPT
missed_detection: Siren clip the classifier gets wrong — EV queues, cost measured
noisy_0db: Siren mixed with road noise at 0 dB SNR
ev_decelerates: EV slows mid-approach — ETA invalidated after trigger
ev_accelerates: EV arrives earlier than predicted — trigger was too late
downstream_spillback: Severe spillback from downstream — preemption must not worsen it
cycle_nearly_complete: Cycle almost finished on arrival — transition edge case
